title: NDS.Live Filling Specification
description: Normative schema for NDS.Live filling specifications, format version 0.4. A document is one product specification: a provider's catalog of what it can deliver, or a product derived from such a catalog (what is delivered to, or asked for by, a customer). Which of the two a file is, is business context, not structure; an optional derivedFrom records the catalog a product was cut from. Changes over 0.3 (FSPEC-21): an optional origin on module, layer and attribute marks custom definitions that are not part of NDS.Live. Changes in 0.3 (FSPEC-14): the specs map with its capability/requirement parts is replaced by a single top-level productSpecification, and the optional derivedFrom linkage is added. Earlier changes: single fillingSpecVersion at the document level (FSPEC-2); validityRangeTypes uses exact NDS.Live validity enum member names (FSPEC-4); namespaced x-* extension objects on productSpecification, module, layer and attribute (REQ-EXT-01..05); optional attribute id (FSPEC-5).

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this document conforms to. The tool stamps this on every export so external readers auto-find the schema.

version.description: Document wrapper version. Bumped when the outer wrapper shape changes; the format itself is versioned by fillingSpecVersion.

fillingSpecVersion.description: The single, authoritative format version of this document.

exportedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp recorded by the producing tool.

derivedFrom.description: Provenance link to the catalog this product specification was derived from (FSPEC-14). Optional and purely informational: it lets tools locate the baseline for comparison and records what the provider offered when the product was cut. Refers to the catalog by its productSpecification id and version.

version.description: productSpecification.version of the catalog at derivation time.

productSpecification.description: The one specification this document carries.

fillingSpecVersion.description: Schema-format version this document claims to conform to.

origin.description: Where the definition comes from (FSPEC-21): "nds" — the official NDS.Live specification, checked against its catalog; "custom" — a company- or organization-specific extension, not part of NDS.Live, which tools must not report as unknown. Absent means "nds". On a module it also covers the module's layers unless a layer says otherwise.

extensions.description: Vendor extension container (REQ-EXT-01..05). Keys are vendor namespaces matching ^x-[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ (e.g. x-here, x-tomtom, x-customer-xyz). Values are opaque to the common schema; vendors bring their own validation. Tools MUST preserve extensions verbatim across import/export (REQ-EXT-04).

productSpecification.description: Envelope for one filling spec instance.

id.description: Stable identifier (slug or URN-ish). e.g. nds.live.demo.isa_map.

dataLifetime.description: Default lifetime for the document. Per-layer lifetime overrides this.

feature.description: Product capability a customer talks about (e.g. Lane Groups (HD), Roads / Intersection).

level.description: NDS tile level. May be a range like "1-14" or a comma list.

layerIds.description: Layer ids (within the same spec) that compose this feature (REQ-FEAT-02).

module.description: NDS module wrapper grouping layers. version is the module-default; per-layer overrides ride on the layer itself.

origin.description: Whether this module is part of NDS.Live or a custom extension; inherited by its layers.

layer.description: A data layer produced or required. id is the user-facing DataLayerId, unique within the enclosing spec.

id.description: User-facing DataLayerId; the ID referenced from smartLayers.dataLayers and features.layerIds.

layerType.description: Fully qualified NDS.Live layer-struct name, e.g. rules.layer.LaneRulesLayer.

origin.description: Whether this layer type is part of NDS.Live or custom; defaults to the enclosing module's origin.

levels.description: NDS tile levels at which the layer is provided.

attributes.description: Attributes this layer carries, referencing attributes[] by id when the definition has one, else by name (FSPEC-5).

primaryContainer.description: Which of the listed containers is the primary delivery container.

moduleVersions.description: Module-version stamps for this layer (e.g. "rules 2026.01"). The first entry implies the layer's owning module/version.

serviceRef.description: smartLayer.id of the service when type is service.

compression.description: Per-layer NDS.Live compression algorithm (e.g. zstd, gzip, none).

signature.description: Per-layer NDS.Live signature algorithm (e.g. SHA-256, none).

encryption.description: Per-layer NDS.Live encryption algorithm (e.g. AES-256, none).

attribute.description: Per-attribute definition. layer.attributes[] entries reference an attribute by its id when present, else by name (FSPEC-5): giving two definitions of the same NDS attribute name distinct ids lets different layers carry different definitions (e.g. PROHIBITED_PASSAGE with different conditions on road vs lane layers).

id.description: Optional stable key, unique within the spec (FSPEC-5). When present, layers reference this id; when absent, the attribute is referenced by name.

origin.description: Whether this attribute type is part of NDS.Live or custom.

validityRangeTypes.description: NDS.Live validity types, exact member names (FSPEC-4). Superset of RoadValidityType, LaneValidityType, RoadLocationRangeValidityType and DrivePathValidityType. Not every value is valid for every feature type; context-invalid values are flagged by the semantic validator (FSPEC-3), never rejected here.

conditions.description: NDS ConditionTypeCode member names (exact, no dot-notation sub-values — REQ-TERM-03).

conditionDetails.description: Optional sub-value detail per condition type (REQ-TERM-03 keeps these out of the type names): keys are ConditionTypeCode names that also appear in conditions[]; values are the selected sub-value names of that condition's value enum (e.g. WEATHER: ["SNOW", "ICE"]). Tools may render them dotted (WEATHER.SNOW) for display.

properties.description: NDS property type member names (CorePropertyType or module PropertyType).

allowedValues.description: Enum value list or numeric range. Unit goes in the unit field.

unit.description: Measurement unit for numeric allowedValues. e.g. km/h, m, %.

regionalDefaultLayer.description: Layer providing the regional default when hasRegionalDefault is YES.

customRequirement.description: Free-form Markdown requirement section. Image references inside the text use ![alt](attachment://N) where N matches an attachment.id within the same array.

attachment.description: Embedded binary (base64 inline). Future revisions may swap base64 for sidefile URLs while keeping the same attachment://id indirection in text.

id.description: Local identifier referenced by attachment://id markers in the parent requirement text.

smartLayer.description: Named delivery service referenced from layer.deliveryMethod.serviceRef.

id.description: References a layer.id in the same spec.
